The cover features colorful, stylized illustrations of characters in action poses, including a figure in a mask and another character falling or flying. The art style is reminiscent of mid-20th-century comics with bold lines and vibrant colors. The paper appears aged with some wear on the edges. Below the main comic, parts of other comic books are visible, suggesting a stack or collection.
